resources.string: Up to 10 intervals; the last repeats
Important reminders use high priority notifications; full screen and DND access depend on system permissions.
Quick create: meeting every Monday at 9
Time not recognized. Use manual creation or the AI assistant.
Test scheduled. Lock the device and wait about a minute; complete or delete it on Home.
Exact alarms unavailable: delivery uses inexact alarms and may be delayed
Notifications depend on permissions, channels, silent mode and DND. Important reminders also require system authorization.
Inexact alarms may be delayed. Allow exact alarms in Settings → Reminder diagnostics.
Notifications are off. After saving, enable and test them in Settings → Reminder diagnostics.

Reminders and completion records stay on this device. AI sends conversations and relevant reminder content to your configured model endpoint. WebDAV uploads backups to your server. Local backups may appear in Downloads; keep them secure.
Conflicts pause sync until you choose. WebDAV snapshots stay in app-private storage. Deletions do not sync.
Both devices changed. Sync paused. Choose which data to keep in Sync settings.
Both devices changed. Sync paused; choose local or remote data.
A local snapshot is saved before applying your choice. Remote data updates matching IDs; local-only reminders are retained.
Data changed. Sync again before choosing.
Sync conflict detected. Choose which data to keep.
Remote revision changed or the server lacks safe conditional updates. Sync stopped without overwriting remote data. Download and check again.
WebDAV sync pauses when both sides change. Choose explicitly; a local snapshot is saved first. Local-only reminders stay scheduled. The legacy protocol cannot sync deletions.
